meta.title: Request a Product | AWS OVERSEAS impex
meta.description: Can't find what you're sourcing in our catalog? Tell us the product you need — name, a short description, a photo, and how much you need — and our sourcing team will get back to you.

hero.title: Looking for something we don't list yet?
hero.subtitle: Tell us what you need — a name and a way to reach you is enough. A description, a photo, and quantity all help, but none of it is required.
hero.note: No account needed — anyone can submit a request.

form.title: Tell us what you're after
form.description: The more you tell us, the faster we can quote it — but only the product name and one way to reach you are required.
form.successMessage: Thanks — we've got your request and will get back to you by email or phone shortly.
